name: spec-build
description: Write a spec, plan it, build it on a cheap capable model, then verify the build against the spec with a reviewer from another family.

stages.title: Spec: {{goal}}
stages.prompt:
Write a precise spec for: {{goal}}
Read the repository first. Cover behavior, inputs and outputs, edge cases, what is out of scope, and acceptance tests a reviewer can check. Do not edit anything.

stages.title: Plan the build
stages.prompt: Turn the spec under 'Inputs from finished work' into an ordered build plan: exact files, steps, and the tests to add. Do not edit anything.

stages.title: Build: {{goal}}
stages.prompt:
Implement the spec by following the plan (both under 'Inputs from finished work'). Goal: {{goal}}
Add the tests the plan names. Commit your work on the current branch with a clear message.

stages.title: Verify the build against the spec
stages.prompt:
Check the build (branch and commit under 'Inputs from finished work') against every acceptance test in the spec. Read the diff and run the tests if you can; do not edit.
Your very last line must be the verdict, exactly in one of these two forms, with no formatting and nothing after it:
VERDICT: PASS
VERDICT: FAIL - <the main reason>
